lines.en: I number every step I take.

lines.zh: 鞋跟夹着三张未归档的纸。
lines.en: Three unfiled pages are stuck in my heel.

lines.zh: 这走廊该编进索引第七卷。
lines.en: This corridor belongs in index volume seven.
I write while walking. My quill cannot rest.

lines.zh: 我的袍角拖过整排书架。
lines.en: My robe drags past the whole shelf row.

lines.zh: 数着地砖，我数到了四百。
lines.en: I count the floor tiles. Four hundred so far.

lines.zh: 墨迹滴在路上，也算记录。
lines.en: Ink drips on the road. That counts as a record.

lines.zh: 别催，档案员走路也校对。
lines.en: Do not rush me. I proofread as I walk.

lines.zh: 我把脚印当作书页编号。
lines.en: I treat my footprints as page numbers.

lines.zh: 怀里这本册子比腿还沉。
lines.en: This ledger weighs more than my legs.
Slower. I am verifying the route.

lines.zh: 每一步都盖一个时间戳。
lines.en: Each step gets its own timestamp.
Page three is blank again.

lines.zh: 我把书脊上的灰吹干净。
lines.en: I blow the dust off a spine.
My quill is blunt. I bite it sharp.
This catalogue is missing one letter.
Emeralds? Log them first, then pocket them.

lines.zh: 书页之间夹着一片干叶。
lines.en: A dried leaf hides between pages.

lines.zh: 我替这排书重新排了序。
lines.en: I reordered this entire shelf.
Quiet. I am memorizing the index.

lines.zh: 有人把纸角折了，不可饶恕。
lines.en: Someone folded a page corner. Unforgivable.

lines.zh: 我在封底画了个小方格。
lines.en: I drew a small square on the back cover.
Look up. Let me see your face clearly.

lines.zh: 你的护甲，该编入外族卷。
lines.en: Your armor belongs in the outsider volume.
I study you over my lenses.
Name? For now I write visitor.

lines.zh: 你站姿很特别，值得记录。
lines.en: Your stance is unusual. Worth recording.
Hold still. I am tracing your outline.

lines.zh: 你的剑有几道缺口，我数了。
lines.en: I counted the notches on your sword.

lines.zh: 你眼睛的颜色，我记下了。
lines.en: I have noted your eye color.
Another reader without an appointment.

lines.zh: 你这么看我是想借书吗？
lines.en: Staring like that, do you want a loan?
Ah. That page is torn.
My ledger slipped from my hands.
You interrupted my sentence.
It hurts, but the record matters more.
My glasses are crooked. I cannot see.
I will note this in the remarks.
Not the glasses. They cost more than my face.
I step back and close the book first.
The ink spilled. All of it.
You have wounded a copyist.
Paper? Hand it over. I am short a page.

lines.zh: 那本书的装订已经松了。
lines.en: That book's binding is already loose.

lines.zh: 绿宝石不错，但书更值钱。
lines.en: Emeralds are fine. Books are worth more.
Keep the bread. I am not hungry.
The paper in your hand smells moldy.
Let me copy one page. Just one.
Which print shop made this cover?

lines.zh: 我不追人，我追散落的页。
lines.en: I chase loose pages, not people.
Set the book down. Slowly.
That ink is the wrong shade. Too thin.
Careful. You scattered a stack of pages.
The ink bottle broke. Do not step there.
My page numbers are all out of order.

lines.zh: 你踩到了第七卷的目录。
lines.en: You stepped on volume seven's index.
Step aside. I am carrying books.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我丢了两张卡片。
lines.en: That bump cost me two cards.
Do not shove. The spine will crack.

lines.zh: 你撞掉的纸，我一张张捡。
lines.en: I pick up every page you knocked down.
Steady. You are standing on my robe.
My bones are light. The books are not.
Would you co-author a volume with me?

lines.zh: 两个人的索引，总比一个人快。
lines.en: Two indexers work faster than one.

lines.zh: 我把你的名字写在扉页。
lines.en: I put your name on the title page.

lines.zh: 我们共用一支笔就够了。
lines.en: One quill would serve us both.

lines.zh: 你若识字，我们便有话谈。
lines.en: If you can read, we have much to discuss.
I saved half the desk for you.
Shall we sort pages until dawn?

lines.zh: 你的字迹，我可以学着认。
lines.en: I could learn to read your handwriting.
Two ledgers side by side. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我把藏书楼的钥匙分你一把。
lines.en: I will cut you a key to the stacks.
Picked up. First, does it have writing?
Neat edges. This paper can be reused.
One emerald, filed under sundries.
Iron scrap? Into the waste drawer.
I tuck this between the pages.
A found book counts as collection.
This coin is badly worn.
I will wipe it clean before logging.
Whose was it? I write source unknown.
One more oddity in my pocket.
A new entry, number zero zero one.
You are logged as pending.

lines.zh: 我把你的名字圈了起来。
lines.en: I circled your name in red.
Do not leave. I have not finished writing.

lines.zh: 这一页需要你一点血样。
lines.en: This page requires a small blood sample.
I close the ledger and look at you.
Someone is about to be archived.
I speak your name, very softly.

lines.zh: 吵闹的读者都要被收走。
lines.en: Noisy readers get removed from the library.

lines.zh: 你毁了我的索引，代价很高。
lines.en: You ruined my index. That costs dearly.
I saved the last page for you.
The record begins. Do not interrupt.
I raise my quill like a short blade.
This entry, I will write in detail.

lines.zh: 你的名字太短，写起来省墨。
lines.en: Your name is short; it saves ink.

lines.zh: 我翻到空白页，正好是你。
lines.en: I turn to a blank page, and it fits you.
The reader has arrived; the record begins.

lines.zh: 我替同伴加上一层附魔。
lines.en: I lay an enchantment on my kin.

lines.zh: 字句落在他们肩上，成了甲。
lines.en: Words settle on their shoulders as armor.
I chant slowly. The effect lasts longer.
Back away. Let me finish this passage.

lines.zh: 你每靠近一步，我加一句。
lines.en: Every step you take, I add a line.

lines.zh: 这本册子会记住你的破绽。
lines.en: This ledger remembers your weak points.
I cast from behind the lectern.
Do not break my sentence.

lines.zh: 附魔需要安静，你不安静。
lines.en: Enchanting needs quiet. You are not quiet.
I drew a cross beneath your name.
My kin are growing stronger.
This line of incantation is just for you.

lines.zh: 你听见纸页翻动的声音吗？
lines.en: Do you hear the pages turning?
I count to ten. You should fall by then.
You back away, so I read faster.
I draw a circle at your feet.

lines.zh: 字条飞出去，贴在你背上。
lines.en: A slip of paper flies out and sticks to your back.

lines.zh: 我背下你的步法，一共三种。
lines.en: I have your gait memorized, all three ways.

lines.zh: 你举盾，我就换一行咒文。
lines.en: You raise a shield, so I switch to another line.
Your weakness is noted in the footer.
The book spine cracks your wrist.
This blow goes in the appendix.
I slap your face with the ledger.
Do not touch my shelves.
A ruler works as a club too.
I jab you with an inked nib.
This strike has a page number. Page eight.

lines.zh: 你弄皱了我最喜欢的一页。
lines.en: You crumpled my favorite page.
I hit lightly, but precisely.

lines.zh: 别以为读书人不会动手。
lines.en: Do not think readers cannot fight.
I pin you against the desk.
Consider this an erratum.

lines.zh: 我的笔尖找到你的手背。
lines.en: My nib finds the back of your hand.
I drive a book corner into your ribs.
The ink pot hits your temple.

lines.zh: 我把书架推倒在你身上。
lines.en: I tip the shelf over onto you.

lines.zh: 尘埃落定，我翻开第一页。
lines.en: The dust settles. I open page one.
This library is under my care.
I step out from between the shelves.
New books require registration.

lines.zh: 我扶正眼镜，清了清嗓子。
lines.en: I straighten my glasses and clear my throat.

lines.zh: 这里的光太暗，不适合阅读。
lines.en: The light here is too dim for reading.
I brush the dust off my robe.

lines.zh: 又一处没整理过的房间。
lines.en: Another room left unsorted.

lines.zh: 我的笔和册子都带来了。
lines.en: I brought my quill and ledger.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这里要有目录。
lines.en: From today, this place gets a catalogue.
I smell old paper.
Who left these books out of order?

lines.zh: 火苗舔到纸角，我心疼纸。
lines.en: Flames lick the page corner. I mourn the paper.

lines.zh: 摔下来时，我护住了册子。
lines.en: As I fell, I guarded the ledger.
Water soaks the pages into pulp.
The blast knocks down a whole shelf.
The arrow pierces a page and sticks there.
My enchantment unravels. The ink fades.
I forgot to eat. I only remembered copying.
Lightning scorched my cover.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有纸，也没有字。
lines.en: The void holds no paper, no words.
